newsitem.title: UK: UK shares notch up another record on Dow rally.
newsitem.headline: UK shares notch up another record on Dow rally.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index was driven to its third record close this week on Friday by the U.S. stock market's seemingly unstoppable rise and by fresh domestic bid activity which helped boost investor confidence.

The FTSE 100 index of leading shares finished up 25.7 points at 4,783.1 but off the day's best levels after an unsuccessful early attempt to jump a key psychological level. FTSE came within a whisker of 4,800, chalking up a best of 4,796.0.
"It has been quite a testing day," said one trader. "The higher the market goes, the more amazed we become. Wall St bubbled off its best but is still beyond the rules of gravity."
